json.evidence: Photo 1 (before work) shows one utility meter and one gray load-center panel beside it, and no other panel on this wall. Photos 2, 3, 4 and 13 show that same panel with its door open and a single breaker array inside. Photos 4-14 show equipment added during the install: a white BASE-labeled enclosure, two small disconnects on the wall, and white battery units on pads. Photos 11 and 14 show conduit running from the meter/panel into the BASE enclosure, which suggests it is fed from the existing service rather than being an independent service.
json.notes: Only one meter and one main panel appear. The BASE enclosure, small disconnects and batteries are battery-system equipment, not extra service mains. The camera resolution is too low to read breaker labels, but nothing suggests a second independent service.
